purpose: Production E2E certification contract for the deployed Repository Supervisor MCP and guarded GitHub runtime. Source tests do not satisfy this contract.

modes.repository_name_guard: must contain e2e, sandbox, or test

merge_requirements: exact planned PR head is unchanged
exact planned commit CI is success
server-side entitlement and GitHub authorization are rechecked
default branch remains at the expected pre-plan head
GitHub repository policy accepts the merge
resulting default branch head equals returned merge commit

evidence_rules: Access tokens are read from environment variables and are never accepted as CLI arguments.
Read E2E must bind audit and assurance to the exact resolved repository head.
Write E2E is allowed only on an explicitly named disposable e2e/sandbox/test repository with explicit confirmation.
The verifier never busy-waits for CI; pending CI exits with code 2 and requires a later explicit rerun.
A successful write E2E receipt must include the plan head, exact-head CI success, merge commit, and verified resulting default-branch head.
No source-only test, mocked fetch, or static validator may be recorded as live production E2E evidence.
